# Impasto recipe

Thick oil laid with a palette knife: large, flat, hard-edged planes of mixed colour, raked by light from the upper left so each ridge of paint casts a line. The world is grey and rainy with a single coloured thing in it. Colour is an event: it gets re-laid stroke by stroke and travels along dabbed paint ribbons. Settle value structure first, keep hard edges at the focus and calm planes elsewhere.

## Look
- Every stroke is a physical object: a slanted plane with a pale ridge where the blade pressed, a dark lip where it lifted, a second colour dragged into the first.
- Paint each plate once, from a flat illustration planned in at least three values, then only move it. Static paint never boils. Only story elements move: rain, figures, bouquet, ribbons, camera.
- Target: graphic and clear, as legible as a picture book at thumbnail size, tactile when cropped in close.
- A film is a few painted plates (wide street, close-up, overhead view) linked by paint-over sweeps. The world begins grey and earns its colour.
- Not a swirl filter where every stroke churns. Not brush texture laid over flat vector art. Not watercolour, because the paint is opaque. Not a photo filter: strokes come from designed shapes, not sampled noise.
- Never dissolve; two layers of ridges blur into mud.

## Surfaces
- Value first: draw the set flat in 3+ values, then convert to strokes. If it fails at 480 px wide, brushwork will not save it.
- Knife stroke: length 1.7-3.1x radius, width 0.95-1.45x radius, slanted ends, angle +-13°, value jitter +-6 %. The far third drags a second colour at 55 %.
- Lit ridge: white line on the light-facing side (alpha 0.1 + 0.3·|k|, 1.6 px). Dark line, 2.2 px, on the opposite side.
- Stroke size follows importance. Coarse in sky, walls, ground: radius 22-28 px, then 9-12, then 4-5 at edges. Fine only at faces and silhouettes. Shrink each stroke until it stays inside its own shape, which keeps silhouettes crisp.
- Underpainting: the flat reference blurred 1.5 px beneath the strokes, so bare canvas never shows. Burn a vignette into the plate.
- Dabs and roses: round blob, pale ring at upper left, dark ring at lower right. A flower = a dab plus a dark swirl.
- Wet reflections: stacks of short horizontal dabs below each light, broken and fading. Never a painted rectangle.
- Rain: two sheets of slanted hairlines (alpha 0.34 and 0.2) scrolling at 1500 and 2600 px/s, stacked so the loop has no seam. Seen from above, the lines radiate from the centre.
- Paint plates at load from a seeded PRNG, then turn them into images: rasterised once, transformed only. No film grain.

## Palette
- `--latar` fixes the value of the grey world. Wall, street and shadow are mixes of `--latar` and `--teks` (`--terang`, `--batu`, `--gelap`, `--bayang`), neutralised with a faint cool cast from the background. Pale brand: light overcast grey. Dark brand: dusk grey.
- `--utama`: the single coloured thing. Main bouquet's wrapping; the hero object in the overhead. `--aksen`: warm second voice. Shawl, first ribbon, lamplight (`--hangat` blends `--aksen` into `--utama`).
- Text on a painted band: `--teks` on `--latar`. Key word of a line in `--utama-di-latar`; phone number in `--aksen-di-latar`. The band itself is paint in `--latar`.
- Fixed for every brand: the knife rainbow of petals, ribbons, umbrellas (skin, blue, pink, green, violet, orange, teal, cream). The grey world keeps at most 5 % colour residue.
- Example values to reuse: wall grey `#8c8c90` to `#5c5c62`, signal red `#dc2f28`, ochre yellow `#f4bc2a`, lamplight orange.

## Type
- `--font-judul`: the title, laid in by knife. Cormorant Garamond 700, 136 px, line height 1.05, filled with a knife-streaked texture of `--teks`, centred on a rough paint plane (1040 x 380).
- `--font-isi`: story lines. Cormorant Garamond 500 italic, 56 px, on a paint band 118 px tall and 64 px from the edge; key word at 700. Title subtitles: 46 px italic (`--teks-redup`) and 50 px at 700 with 0.03 em tracking.
- Only the title is cut from paint. Small text stays crisp DOM text, since a knife cannot carry it.
- No brand fonts: a high-contrast serif (Cormorant Garamond, Playfair Display) throughout.
- Each line sweeps in from the left over 0.4 s (clip inset, `power2.out`) and stays at least 2.2 s.

## Timing
- Unhurried and smooth; no stepping. A beat is a sweep of paint, not a fade or a slide.
- 15 s example:
  - 0-1.0 s grey street; bouquet sways 4° on a 1.5 s sine.
  - 1.0-3.0 s close-up; camera eases from 1.12 to 0.93 while still grey.
  - 3.0 s bouquet rises 560 px and lands `back.out(1.5)` in 0.42 s.
  - 3.3 s colour blooms from it as a jagged circle growing to 2700 px in 0.7 s (cubic in-out); three ribbons draw over 1 s.
  - 4.4 s wide street via a 0.45 s paint-over sweep, then a slow push 1.03 to 1.07.
  - From 4.75 s ten ribbon targets pop, one per 0.42 s: 0.14 s knife wipe, 1.12x bounce, seven paint specks arcing over 0.55 s.
  - 9.35 s overhead: camera rises and rotates 0.3 rad over 3.3 s; 16 bouquets spiral in from 1500+ px (1.1 s each, 0.07 s apart) leaving dabbed trails.
  - 11.7 s the name is laid in; everything holds still 12.6-15 s.
- Eases: sweeps and camera cubic in-out; arrivals cubic out; pops `power2.out` with yoyo; ribbons cubic out. Linear is for rain only.
- Ribbon = three parallel dabbed paths in different colours (dab 14-34 px, gap 35-105 % of dab), drawn lengthwise by a growing dash array.

## Camera
The camera is a frame travelling over a finished plate: focus point, scale, slight rotation. Keep it inside the plate (half-width = 960 / zoom) or canvas edge shows.
- Slow pull-back from a grey close-up (1.12 to 0.93): waiting, the world replying. A customer's doubt; a lonely routine; a story's low point.
- Same close-up, colour blooming from an object: a gift arrives, change begins. A product reaching someone; a lesson landing; good news.
- Wide street, slow push (1.03 to 1.07): a place observed, a network. Delivery routes; a neighbourhood; a class's students.
- Rotating crane-out from overhead (1.25 to 0.92, 0.3 rad): a pattern forming out of many. Crowd; community; event guests.
- Same wide shot twice, grey then coloured: before and after. Renovation; season; brand relaunch.
- Locked final frame: the finished picture. Name, address, call to action.

## Signature moves
- The one coloured thing: grey world, one object in full colour. For: a florist's bouquet; one child in a school photo; a lantern in a night story; a signature dish.
- Colour re-laid by the knife: a jagged-edged circle of colour spreads from the object and repaints the plate. For: a town waking; a patient recovering; a shop reopening; a season turning.
- Paint ribbons: three dabbed paths in different colours arc from a source to whatever it reaches; each target pops into colour on arrival. For: delivery routes; a newsletter reaching readers; a song heard along a street; a class graduating.
- Paint-over sweep: the next plate is wiped across the last with a jagged edge in 0.45 s. For: a timeline of versions; memory replacing the present; chapters of a trip.
- Overhead choreography: round painted objects spiral in from beyond the frame and settle around a name. For: a colour catalogue; arriving guests; a team; market stalls.
- Line on paint: one short sentence on a rough band in the background colour. For: caption; quote; price; one-line promise.

## Avoid
- Strokes confined to a shape shrink near the edge and leave canvas outlines. Keep the blurred underpainting.
- Order matters in the flat reference: paint ground before building feet and people.
- Bare rectangles look like blocks. Taper each silhouette, add a lit edge, and place a dab or two to define it.
- Re-seeding strokes per frame makes paint boil. Paint once from a fixed seed.
- Small text over knife strokes is unreadable. Use crisp DOM text on a band.
- No dissolves between plates; sweep or cut.
- Load-time painting is slow: keep plates at the sizes given and paint the overhead plate at half resolution.

# Thick oil paint: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.2, medium 2.4, long 4.6.

## hook

- en: a grey rainy street in knife strokes; one object in full colour, the only colour in the world, a short line on a painted band
- id: jalan kelabu berhujan dari guratan pisau; satu benda berwarna penuh, satu-satunya warna, kalimat pendek di bidang cat

## problem

- en: a grey close-up of the one who waits; the camera eases back slowly through the rain, nothing else moves
- id: close-up kelabu orang yang menunggu; kamera mundur pelan di tengah hujan, yang lain diam

## fact

- en: a locked wide; one detail is re-laid in colour by a knife sweep while the rest stays grey
- id: frame lebar terkunci; satu detail dilapis ulang warna oleh sapuan pisau, sisanya tetap kelabu

## step

- en: one painted object per step pops from grey to colour on the beat, a dabbed paint ribbon arcing to each
- id: satu benda per langkah berubah dari kelabu ke warna tepat di ketukan, pita cat putus-putus melengkung ke tiap benda

## compare

- en: the same wide twice: grey for before, then re-laid in colour stroke by stroke for after
- id: frame lebar yang sama dua kali: kelabu untuk sebelum, lalu dilapis warna guratan demi guratan untuk sesudah

## number

- en: the figure laid in with the knife on a calm dark painted plane, a small crisp label beside it
- id: angka dilapis pisau di bidang cat gelap yang tenang, label kecil yang tajam di sampingnya

## proof

- en: a wide street; paint ribbons arc from the source to each window, which pops into colour one per beat
- id: jalan lebar; pita cat melengkung dari sumbernya ke tiap jendela, yang menyala warna satu per ketukan

## offer

- en: the coloured object arrives in the grey close-up and colour spreads from it as scattered knife strokes
- id: benda berwarna tiba di close-up kelabu, lalu warna menyebar darinya sebagai guratan pisau yang acak

## cta

- en: overhead: round painted objects swirl in leaving dabbed trails, the name laid in at the centre, held 2.4 s
- id: dari atas: benda bundar berputar masuk meninggalkan jejak cat, nama dilapis pisau di tengah, diam 2,4 detik

## payoff

- en: the camera cranes out rotating over the pattern the motion painted, then holds still on it 2 s
- id: kamera naik sambil berputar di atas pola yang dilukis gerakan, lalu diam di sana 2 detik
